## Problem

What user, contributor, security or architecture problem does this solve?

## Change

Describe the smallest useful change made here.

## Verification

- [ ] I ran the relevant tests
- [ ] I ran `npx tsc --noEmit` for frontend TypeScript changes
- [ ] I ran `npm run test:security` when security-sensitive behavior changed
- [ ] I ran or considered the production build for runtime/config changes
- [ ] I did not add credentials, private documents, production identifiers or signing material
- [ ] I considered local/offline behavior
- [ ] I documented any new remote data boundary or provider configuration
- [ ] I updated documentation when behavior or setup changed
- [ ] Any new substantial dependency follows `docs/DEPENDENCY_POLICY.md`

## Visual evidence

Include screenshots or a recording for meaningful UI changes when useful. Use copyright-safe content and remove personal information.

## Reviewer focus

Call out migrations, compatibility concerns, security implications, provider/privacy changes, follow-up work or areas where focused review would help.
